objects.description: Alias type for LGFX that makes LovyanGFX behave like TFT_eSPI. This is a type alias, not a new class; all construction, destruction, and behavior are those of LGFX from LovyanGFX.hpp.

Wrapper class derived from LGFX_Sprite providing TFT_eSPI-compatible naming. Constructors enable PSRAM usage by setting the protected _psram flag to true and optionally accept a LovyanGFX parent. Adds frameBuffer(uint8_t) method that returns the internal buffer via getBuffer(). Lifecycle and most behavior are inherited from LGFX_Sprite (defined externally).

functions.name: TFT_eSprite::frameBuffer
functions.description: Returns a raw pointer to the sprite’s internal pixel buffer. This provides compatibility with the TFT_eSPI API; the uint8_t parameter is accepted for signature compatibility but is not used. Typical usage is to obtain the buffer after the sprite’s storage has been allocated (e.g., via createSprite) so you can directly read or write pixel data.
requirements: This must be called on a valid TFT_eSprite instance whose pixel buffer has been allocated (e.g., after calling createSprite); otherwise the returned pointer may be nullptr.
Callers must check the returned pointer for nullptr before dereferencing.
The uint8_t argument is ignored; any value is accepted.
The returned pointer is owned by the sprite; callers must not free it.
The pointer may become invalid if the sprite is destroyed or its buffer is reallocated (e.g., due to size/depth changes); avoid retaining it across such operations.
